claims.head: Something has to give
claims.body: The Capitals are one of the league’s best for chance quality, but the Kraken are near the top at preventing dangerous shots. Our lean: the Capitals’ chance quality wins out.

claims.body: The Capitals are near the top of the league for shots from in close, and the Kraken are near the bottom. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one. Shots from in close tend to be the more dangerous ones.

items.text: The Kraken are newly without Cale Fleury.
Jordan Kyrou has seven goals in nine games against Seattle since 2023-24, most of them with St. Louis.
Bobby McMann has four goals in six games against Washington since 2023-24, most of them with Toronto.
Alex Ovechkin is still looking for his first goal of the season.
